tasks.title: Set up Azure SQL and bootstrap DB
tasks.description: Provision Azure SQL Server & database; create baseline schema and CI connection.
tasks.details: Create resource group, Azure SQL logical server, DB. Configure firewall, managed identity, and connection string secrets.
tasks.testStrategy: Connect from local dev and from app service using managed identity; run smoke query.

tasks.title: Model core entities (System, Subsystem, Attribute, User, Dependency, AuditLog)
tasks.description: Implement EF Core entities and migrations for all core models.
tasks.details: Include hierarchy for System↔Subsystem, flexible key/value Attribute model with types, Dependency edges, and append-only AuditLog.
tasks.testStrategy: Apply migration to empty DB; CRUD each entity; verify FK constraints and cascade rules.

subtasks.title: Define entities and value objects
subtasks.description: Design ER model; implement Domain entities/value objects
subtasks.details: Update Domain/Entities and ValueObjects for System, Subsystem, Attribute, DependencyEdge, AuditLog; include navigation, constraints, and enums.

subtasks.title: EF Core configurations and DbSets
subtasks.description: Add entity configurations and register DbSets
subtasks.details: Create configurations under Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations; register DbSets in ApplicationDbContext; configure relationships, keys, delete behavior, indexes.

subtasks.title: Initial migrations (MSSQL)
subtasks.description: Create baseline EF Core migration and apply locally
subtasks.details: Use Migrators.MSSQL to add and apply initial migration for new entities; verify schema created in dev DB.

subtasks.title: Seed data and indexes
subtasks.description: Add minimal seed and performance indexes
subtasks.details: Seed essential lookup data; create indexes for common queries; place seeding in ApplicationDbContextInitializer and/or migrations as appropriate.

subtasks.title: Unit tests for entities/configs
subtasks.description: Write tests for entity rules and EF configurations
subtasks.details: Add tests in tests/Application.UnitTests and/or Infrastructure.UnitTests to assert validation, relationships, and configuration mappings.

tasks.title: Blazor Server shell & auth scaffolding
tasks.description: Create Blazor Server project with .NET Identity/claims and layout.
tasks.details: Add login, roles (CIO, Architect, Owner, ChangeManager). Wire to DB.
tasks.testStrategy: Login flow works; role claims present; unauthorized routes blocked.

tasks.title: System Registry CRUD (hierarchy)
tasks.description: CRUD pages for System/SubSystem with tree view and details panel.
tasks.details: Tree/list, create/edit forms, owner assignment, paging/filtering.
tasks.testStrategy: Create parent & child systems; verify shown in hierarchy; owner visible.

subtasks.title: Define DTOs and AutoMapper profiles
subtasks.description: Create DTOs for System and Subsystem hierarchy and mapping profiles
subtasks.details: Place under Application/Features/ITSystems (or Systems)/DTOs and Mappings; include child collections, owner info, and minimal fields for list vs details.

subtasks.title: Create Commands + Validators
subtasks.description: Implement Create/Update/Delete commands for System and Subsystem with FluentValidation
subtasks.details: Handlers must use IApplicationDbContextFactory.CreateAsync; enforce unique names per parent and ownership rules.

subtasks.title: Create Queries + Caching
subtasks.description: List/paged tree and GetById queries; integrate FusionCache where appropriate
subtasks.details: Use ProjectTo for efficient selects; add cache keys in Application/Features/Systems/Caching.

subtasks.title: CQRS Handlers + Unit Tests
subtasks.description: Implement handlers using DbContextFactory; add unit tests for validators and handlers
subtasks.details: Handlers in Application; tests in tests/Application.UnitTests; mock factory and ensure no UI/Infrastructure leakage.

subtasks.title: Blazor UI pages and components
subtasks.description: Build list/tree page, details panel, and create/edit dialogs
subtasks.details: Pages under Server.UI/Pages/ITSystems; use Mediator for data; adhere to _Imports.razor standard injections.

tasks.title: Attribute Management UI & API
tasks.description: Add attributes dynamically, with data types and validation rules.
tasks.details: Types: text, number, enum, bool, date. Flags: required, scoped-to-level. Server-side validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Create new attribute types; attach to systems; invalid data rejected.

subtasks.title: Define Attribute schema and validators
subtasks.description: Decide attribute types and validation rules; create validators
subtasks.details: Model server-side validation for required, ranges, enums; FluentValidation rules; plan extension points.

subtasks.title: Commands/Queries for attributes
subtasks.description: Implement CRUD and attach-to-system flows via CQRS
subtasks.details: Use DbContextFactory; ensure unique per-system constraints as needed; ProjectTo for list/detail.

subtasks.title: Blazor forms with validation
subtasks.description: Create UI forms for attribute creation and assignment with server validation
subtasks.details: Use MudBlazor components; display validation messages; permission-aware actions.

tasks.title: Backfill workflow for new attributes
tasks.description: Prompt users to populate newly added attributes across all systems.
tasks.details: Generate backlog list; bulk edit grid; progress meter; skip/justify.
tasks.testStrategy: Add attribute; see N backfill items; bulk update persists correctly.

tasks.title: Role-based access enforcement
tasks.description: Apply fine-grained permissions across pages and APIs.
tasks.details: CIO: full; Architect: edit + dependencies; Owner: only their systems; ChangeManager: read + audit.
tasks.testStrategy: Matrix test: each role attempts CRUD; only allowed actions succeed.

subtasks.title: Define permissions and policies
subtasks.description: Add permission constants and register policies
subtasks.details: Place constants in Application/Common/Security; add policies in Server.UI Program/DI; use [Authorize(Policy=...)] in pages.

subtasks.title: UI permission checks
subtasks.description: Integrate PermissionService checks in Blazor components
subtasks.details: Use PermissionService.GetAccessRightsAsync patterns per repo rules; hide/disable actions accordingly.

tasks.title: Dependency Mapping (table view)
tasks.description: Create tabular view to add/list system-to-system relationships.
tasks.details: Support upstream/downstream and notes; de-duplicate edges.
tasks.testStrategy: Add edges both ways; table shows unique, consistent directionality.

tasks.title: Dependency Mapping (visual diagram)
tasks.description: Interactive diagram view for dependencies (pan/zoom, select, add).
tasks.details: Use Blazor.Diagrams (or equivalent). Highlight selected node neighborhood.
tasks.testStrategy: Render 50-node graph smoothly; add/remove edge via canvas.

tasks.title: Change logging (server-side audit)
tasks.details: EF interceptors or service layer hooks; immutable audit entries with diff.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform edits; corresponding audit entries created and immutable.

subtasks.title: Audit write pipeline
subtasks.description: Implement EF interceptor or service hook for append-only audit
subtasks.details: Capture user, entity, changes (diff), timestamp; ensure immutability and backfill support.

tasks.title: Audit Trail UI
tasks.description: Provide searchable audit view for Change Managers.
tasks.details: Filters by user, entity, date; export CSV/PDF.
tasks.testStrategy: Filter by entity/date; export matches on-screen rows.

tasks.title: Reporting: CIO dashboards
tasks.details: Cards + charts; drill-through to system list; perf tuned queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Charts load <2s on 1k systems; drill links correct.

tasks.title: Reporting: Roadmap timeline & compliance gaps
tasks.description: Timeline of planned changes and attribute-based compliance gaps.
tasks.details: Gantt-style roadmap; compliance = required attributes missing/expired.
tasks.testStrategy: Gantt renders and groups by owner; compliance count matches query.

tasks.title: Excel import/export (future)
tasks.description: One-click import from legacy workbook and export/sync.
tasks.details: Mapper from known sheets; idempotent upserts; export filters.
tasks.testStrategy: Round-trip sample Excel yields no diffs.

tasks.title: Workflow approvals (future)
tasks.testStrategy: Happy path + rejection path recorded in audit.
